# beacon_component (Resource)

A component (service) shown on a status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beacon_component" "api" {
  status_page = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name        = "API"
  description = "Public REST API"

  # Monitors and the ingest API change status at runtime.
  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [status]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `status_page` (String) Slug of the status page this belongs to (e.g. `beacon_status_page.main.slug`). Renaming the page's slug is followed in place; moving to a different page is not supported (taint the resource instead).

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `position` (Number)
- `status` (String) Defaults to `operational`. Monitors and the ingest API change this at runtime; leave it unset (or add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [status] }`) unless Terraform should own it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <status_page_slug>/<component_id>
terraform import beacon_component.api acme-cloud/42
```
